paragraphs: Rezcomm sells an ecommerce marketplace platform that unites ecommerce, CRM, reservations, BI and marketing for travel hubs, venues and service providers. The platform brings unlimited products together in a single checkout for customers who manage parking, travel, events or retail. Security certification listed on the site covers PCI DSS Level 1 v4.0 and Cyber Essentials Plus.

For airports, the platform covers parking and ancillary services, digital engagement and loyalty, with the aim of optimising non-aeronautical income. Parking operators are offered parking and upgrades from a single platform built to support multi-site operations, including city-centre and off-airport locations. Cruise terminals are offered digital bookings and integrated services covering port arrival and check-in.

The clients page names airports, venues and travel hubs worldwide as the organisations Rezcomm supports. Belfast International Airport is described as creating a marketplace for selling parking and other ancillaries in partnership with Rezcomm. Sentinel Car Parks, located near Leeds Bradford Airport, partnered with Rezcomm to work on customer experience and revenue streams.

quote.text: Originally built for airports, Rezcomm now powers travel hubs, venues, and service providers of all kinds.
